_: The Moves and Phone line of every card (A-19 P6). A card not listed under `cards` takes `defaults`. Edit here, run `node .design-sync/moves.mjs`, and the previews and MOVES.md follow; `design-sync-moves.test.ts` fails when they have not. Verbs are the ones in src/lib/motion: press, tint, settle, arrive, unfold, leave, crossfade, glide, flash, bloom, lift, breathe. Every one has a still form, and the line says it.

defaults.moves: Nothing on it moves. Still: the same.

AdvancedLink.moves: The underline tints in on hover. From Basic to an Advanced-only page it sets the view first: the switch glides and the Advanced rail unfolds. Still: the switch is instant.
AdvancedLink.phone: 44px tap floor, through the tablet range; it returns to its dense size at the desktop breakpoint.

Button.moves: Presses 3%, colour on tint. Busy, its dot breathes and the label and width hold. Still: no scale, the dot holds.
Button.phone: 44px tap floor, through the tablet range; it returns to its dense size at the desktop breakpoint.

ButtonLink.moves: Presses 3%, colour on tint. Still: no scale.
ButtonLink.phone: 44px tap floor, through the tablet range; it returns to its dense size at the desktop breakpoint.

Modal.moves: Settles in (scale 0.98, 8px) with the scrim leading by 40ms; closing fades first, and is quicker. Still: appears and goes at once.
Modal.phone: Becomes a bottom sheet that rises from the edge; its grabber drags it down to close.

ModalHeader.moves: Moves with its dialog. Still: the same.

ModalFooter.moves: Moves with its dialog. Still: the same.
ModalFooter.phone: Its buttons take the 44px tap floor.

RehearsalDialog.moves: Settles in as a Modal; each step tints in where the last was. The result lifts only when something went well. Still: steps swap at once.
RehearsalDialog.phone: A bottom sheet, as every Modal.

PushedStep.moves: Settles in as a Modal. Still: appears at once.
PushedStep.phone: A bottom sheet, as every Modal.

GoTo.moves: Settles in as a Modal. Still: appears at once.
GoTo.phone: Becomes the Go to a page sheet with the Input at its top; the page list stays until something is typed.

GoToPanel.moves: Nothing on it moves. Still: the same.
GoToPanel.phone: Sits above the page list inside the sheet.

AccountSheet.moves: Settles in as a Modal. Still: appears at once.
AccountSheet.phone: A bottom sheet, as every Modal.

ActionOutcome.moves: Done lifts 6px and its dot blooms once; everything else tints in where it stands. A forecast crossfades to the true word. Still: appears in place, no bloom.
ActionOutcome.phone: Wraps under the row; the row's height holds.

StatusDot.moves: Blooms once, only for something that went well because of you. Still: the dot, without the bloom.

EmptyState.moves: Lifts into place when the list just emptied in front of you, and blooms its dot if your act emptied it; otherwise tints in. Still: appears in place.

ArriveList.moves: Internal: never mounted alone. Rows rise 8px on a first paint you navigated to, 40ms apart, the stagger capped at five; never on Back, refresh, filter or sort. Still: they are simply there.
ArriveList.phone: The same at every width. Carries the list's arrow keys on a keyboard.

LeavingRow.moves: Internal: never mounted alone. A row that goes on a later read fades where it was, then its gap closes on settle; it waits while the pointer or focus is inside. Still: it goes at once.

TechnicalDetail.moves: Opens by Unfold (settle, contents tint in behind); closes fade first. Nothing inside moves. Still: opens and closes at once.
TechnicalDetail.phone: The same row; the block wraps at the card's width, a long id breaks anywhere, the chevron's seat is 44px.

Unfold.moves: Opens to its own height and pushes the page; closing fades first, then folds. Still: opens and closes at once.

Tinted.moves: Tints in where it appears; nothing travels. Still: appears in place.

UnfoldOnArrival.moves: Opens by Unfold when it arrives late, never twice inside a wrapper. Still: appears at once.

Crossfade.moves: One seat whose words change in place: the old layer fades out and the new fades in on tint, in the same cell, so nothing shifts. Still: the words swap at once.

CopiedSeat.moves: Copy crossfades to Copied for 900ms and a dot that went somewhere blooms once. Still: the word swaps at once.

GlideIndicator.moves: Internal: never mounted alone. A fill or underline that glides to the choice on settle while the labels tint; outside the travel cap. Still: it jumps.

Segmented.moves: Its indicator glides to the choice on settle. Still: it jumps.
Segmented.phone: Can span its container with equal segments, as the phone sheet's form.

FilterPills.moves: Its indicator glides to the choice on settle. Still: it jumps.

Tabs.moves: Its underline glides to the tab on settle. Still: it jumps.
Tabs.phone: Holds one height on every screen.

PaginationRow.moves: Show more arrives only the new rows; back to ten glides to the heading and trims out of sight. Still: the rows are there, the glide is a jump.

Skeleton.moves: Tints in. A read that lands inside 200ms never shows it (ReadGate holds it back). Still: the same.

RowSkeleton.moves: Appears only after 200ms, then tints out as the rows tint in. Still: swaps at once.

ReadFreshness.moves: Only a read you pressed for blooms, for a second. Still: the age, without the bloom.

Notice.moves: Opens by Unfold when it arrives late, never twice inside a wrapper; a live amber dot breathes (2400ms, 50% to full) for as long as the condition lasts, and it is the only thing that loops. Still: appears at once, the dot rests at full strength.

Sidebar.moves: A count that changed while you looked elsewhere flashes its row once; the number never ticks. Still: the flash stays, colour only.
Sidebar.phone: Hidden below the tablet breakpoint; TouchNav takes its place.

TouchNav.moves: The Go to a page sheet rises from the edge. Still: appears at once.
TouchNav.phone: This is the phone: the tab bar, and the sheet for the rest of the pages.

AppShell.moves: Nothing moves in the frame. Still: the same.
AppShell.phone: The sidebar gives way to TouchNav; the page takes the full width.

SelectionBar.moves: The count changes without ticking: counts never animate. Still: the same.
SelectionBar.phone: The verb the filter was for leads and the rest wait under More changes, a sheet; its buttons take the 44px floor.

Card.moves: Never scales. A stale one recedes to the canvas ground and rises back as a tint of surface and edge on settle. Still: the tint is at once.
Card.phone: A row with more than two facts discloses the rest rather than wrapping.

Kbd.moves: None. It is text. Still: the same.
Kbd.phone: Drawn only on the Keys sheet and Go to's footer, which a phone does not show.

KeysSheet.moves: Settles in as a Modal. Still: appears at once.
KeysSheet.phone: A bottom sheet, as every Modal; a phone has no `?` key, so it is opened from a keyboard only.

Checkbox.moves: The fill tints in on 120ms and the tick settles in from 60%, 40ms behind it; the seat presses 3%. Still: the tick is simply there, no scale.
Checkbox.phone: 24px seat on touch, 16px from the desktop breakpoint; its hit area stays 24px either way.

Radio.moves: The fill tints in on 120ms and the tick settles in from 60%, 40ms behind it; the seat presses 3%. Still: the tick is simply there, no scale.
Radio.phone: 24px seat on touch, 16px from the desktop breakpoint; its hit area stays 24px either way.

Seat.moves: The fill tints in on 120ms and the tick settles in from 60%, 40ms behind it; the seat presses 3%. Still: the tick is simply there, no scale.
Seat.phone: 24px seat on touch, 16px from the desktop breakpoint; its hit area stays 24px either way.

ChoiceRow.moves: The row tints with the choice on 120ms and its seat does as Checkbox's does: the tick settles in from 60% and the seat presses 3%. Still: no scale, the tick is simply there.

AnchoredPanel.moves: Opens on settle, rising 4px; goes by fading on tint where it stands. Still: appears and goes at once.

ConfirmByTyping.moves: The border warms toward danger with each letter that still matches, to 70% at the full name and never 100; a wrong letter returns it to neutral, and nothing shakes. Still: the same, a colour only.

CopyableValue.moves: Copy crossfades to Copied for 900ms and a dot that went somewhere blooms once; it presses 3%. Still: the word swaps at once, no bloom, no scale.
CopyableValue.phone: The block form is 52px tall and its Copy button takes the 44px floor.

ViewSwitch.moves: Its indicator glides to the choice on settle, and the page's Advanced parts unfold or fold with it. Still: the indicator jumps and the parts appear at once.
ViewSwitch.phone: Keeps the 44px touch floor Segmented carries below the desktop breakpoint.

SyndraMark.moves: Blooms its dot once, the first time it is on screen in a browser session (the rail's mark above tablet, the top bar's on a phone); then still. Still: no bloom.
SyndraMark.phone: Seated in the top bar below tablet, where the rail that holds it is hidden.

Badge.moves: Nothing on it moves. Still: the same.

Chip.moves: Nothing on it moves. Still: the same.

Mono.moves: Nothing on it moves. Still: the same.

CountChip.moves: Nothing on it moves. Still: the same.

ChosenChip.moves: Tints in and rises 4px into its seat; its ✕ tints on hover. Still: appears in place.

SortHead.moves: The arrow turns on settle; a re-sort fades the rows out and in on tint, and nothing travels. Still: the arrow jumps and the rows swap at once.

RunLabel.moves: Moves with its SortHead: the rows fade out and in on tint. Still: they swap at once.

FilterChip.moves: Tints in where it appears and fades out where it stands when the filter is taken away elsewhere; its ✕ presses 3%. Still: appears and goes at once, no scale.
FilterChip.phone: The ✕ has a 44px target through the tablet range; compact from the desktop breakpoint.

WaitsMark.moves: Its note tints in on hover or focus; nothing travels. Still: appears at once.

ThemeToggle.moves: The sun and moon crossfade on tint and the control presses 3%; the page's colours then crossfade for 300ms, and nothing moves. Still: the swap is at once, no scale.
ThemeToggle.phone: A 44px target through the tablet range; 32px from the desktop breakpoint.

StatCard.moves: Hover draws its edge on tint; pressed, it darkens one step to --tint-3. Never scales. Still: the same.

FormPart.moves: A part the reader adds opens to its own height with its contents tinting in one tint behind; removed, it fades first, then its gap settles. Still: it is there and gone at once.

SectionPill.moves: Drops in 10px on settle once the read line has scrolled away, and leaves by fading where it stands; its links press 3%. Still: appears at once, no scale.

ReadLine.moves: Its chips press 3%; a step glides the page to the section and the place it lands flashes once. Still: the glide is a jump, the flash stays as colour.
ReadLine.phone: Each chip takes the 44px floor; compact from the desktop breakpoint.

SignInRow.moves: The body opens to its own height by Unfold, closing fades first, then folds; the chevron turns on settle and presses 3%. Still: opens and closes at once.
SignInRow.phone: Stacks: time and verdict on one line, then the person, then what was asked.

CardRow.moves: A row that opens something tints to --hover and darkens to --tint-3 pressed, and never scales; its body opens by Unfold. Still: opens at once, the tint stays.
CardRow.phone: A row with more than two facts discloses the rest rather than wrapping.

ReadGate.moves: The skeleton appears only if the read is still going after 200ms and fades when it lands; the content then arrives. It never crossfades. Still: the swap is at once.

FoldChevron.moves: Turns on settle, the Unfold's own duration and curve. Still: it turns at once.

StatusSeat.moves: The word crossfades in its seat on tint; its dot blooms once only for something that went well because of you. Still: the word swaps at once, no bloom.

Input.moves: The border and ring colours tint on 120ms; an error line tints in. Still: the same.

Textarea.moves: The border and ring colours tint on 120ms; an error line tints in. Still: the same.

Select.moves: The border tints on 120ms. Still: the same.

Term.moves: Its popover opens on settle, rising 4px, and fades out on tint. Still: appears and goes at once.

FilterPanel.moves: Opens on settle, rising 4px; its trigger presses 3%. Still: appears at once, no scale.

FilterField.moves: Moves with its panel. Still: the same.

TopBar.moves: The mark blooms once on a phone's first paint; its controls press 3%. Still: no bloom, no scale.
TopBar.phone: Carries the mark, since the rail that holds it is hidden.

SelectionAction.moves: Presses 3%, colour on tint. Still: no scale.

RowCheckbox.moves: Presses 3%, colour on tint. Still: no scale.

SelectModeToggle.moves: Presses 3%, colour on tint. Still: no scale.

SelectAllRow.moves: Presses 3%, colour on tint. Still: no scale.

DegradedBanner.moves: Opens by Unfold when it arrives, and folds by fading first. Still: appears and goes at once.

OfflineBanner.moves: Opens by Unfold when it arrives, and folds by fading first. Still: appears and goes at once.

CommandBlock.moves: Its copy control presses 3% and crossfades to Copied. Still: the word swaps at once, no scale.

ClipboardUnavailableNote.moves: Copy crossfades to Copied for 900ms and presses 3%. Still: the word swaps at once.

NotOpenYet.moves: Tints in where it appears; nothing travels. Still: appears in place.

SkeletonCardList.moves: Tints in; the 200ms wait lives in ReadGate. Still: the same.

Unresolved.moves: The copy control beside the id presses 3% and crossfades to Copied. Still: no scale.

ListStates.moves: The skeleton waits 200ms and fades out as the rows arrive; an empty or failed list appears in place. Still: swaps at once.
